from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/darood-un-par-salam-un-par-mere-nabi-ka-jo-hai-gharana-nw-f11c652ee775.md')
header, body = p.read_bytes().split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
metadata, roman = header.decode().split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
changes = {
'Darud un par salam un par Mere nabi ka jo hai gharana': 'Darud un par salaam un par mere Nabi ka jo hai gharaana',
'Hai jin kay dam se jahan ki ronaq , Jahan ka mosam bhi hai suhana': 'Hai jin ke dam se jahaan ki ronaq, jahaan ka mausam bhi hai suhaana',
'Maqam e Mehboob e Kibriya ki, Nahiṅ hai wussat mere bayan maiṅ': 'Maqaam-e-Mahbub-e-Kibriya ki, nahiṅ hai wusat mere bayaan meiṅ',
'Rehman Khud ka raha hai Sallu, Alla ka har waqt yeh tarana': 'Rahmaan khud ka raha hai sallu, Allaah ka har waqt yeh taraana',
'Bana kay Taswir Murtaza ki, kaha yeh jibril se Khuda ne': 'Bana ke taswir Murtaza ki, kaha yeh Jibril se Khuda ne',
'Rahay na koi kami kahi par, Luta do sub hussn ka Khazana': 'Rahe na koi kami kahiṅ par, luta do sab husn ka khazaana',
'Kaniz e Khaliq Janab e Zehra, Jin k dum se haya jahan maiṅ': 'Kaniz-e-Khaaliq Janaab-e-Zehra, jin ke dam se haya jahaan meiṅ',
'Zuban kholain to ayatain ho, rukay to Tathir ka fasana': 'Zabaan kholeṅ to aayateṅ ho, ruke to tathir ka fasaana',
'Hasan jahan ka amir aisa, hayat jibril sa farishta': 'Hasan jahaan ka amir aisa, hayaat Jibril sa farishta',
'Bahisht Jageer mujtaba ki, Hai jis main Panjtan ka ana jan': 'Bahisht jaagir Mujtaba ki, hai jis meiṅ Panjtan ka aana jaan',
'Husain sabr o shukar ki manzil, Husain waris e Anbiya hain': 'Husain sabr o shukr ki manzil, Husain waaris-e-anbiya haiṅ',
'Husain azmat do jahan hai, jissay na bhule ga yeh zaman': 'Husain azmat do jahaan hai, jise na bhulega yeh zamaan',
'Aie mere parwardigar hum ko, dikha day karb o bala ki nagri': 'Ae mere parwardigaar ham ko, dikha de karb o bala ki nagri',
'Jaha pay imran aur anjum, ada krain soz panjagana': 'Jahaaṅ pe Imraan aur Anjum, ada kareṅ soz panjagaana',
}
for old, new in changes.items():
    assert old in roman
    roman = roman.replace(old, new)
roman = roman.replace(' (x1)', '')
updated = (metadata + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + roman).encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + body
p.write_bytes(updated)
assert p.read_bytes().split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == body
assert sum(bool(line.strip()) for line in roman.splitlines()) == sum(bool(line.strip()) for line in body.splitlines())
PY"
